consequence.statement: An operator who does nothing sees no operational change; the optional field spec.proxySecretRef simply becomes available for new or existing Provider resources (notification.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta3).

assertion.statement: A computed artifact diff between the flux2 v2.6.4 and v2.7.0 install bundles shows the notification.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta3 Provider CRD schema gains the new field spec.proxySecretRef (with subfield spec.proxySecretRef.name); it is an additive schema change with no stated behavior or consequence for existing resources.
